events.name: EntitlementMgmt-SubjectAccess.ReadWrite
events.before: Allows the app to manage self-service entitlement management resources on behalf of the signed-in user.  This includes operations such as requesting access and approving access of others.
events.after: Allows the app to manage self-service entitlement management resources on behalf of the signed-in user. This includes operations such as requesting access and approving access of others.

events.name: Perception.Manage.All
events.text: Allows the app to read Agentic Security resources, create sessions and request cancellation on behalf of the signed-in user, subject to the user's access.

events.name: Perception.Read.All
events.text: Allows the app to read Agentic Security playbook definitions, sessions, agent runs, inputs, outputs and messages on behalf of the signed-in user, subject to the user's access.

events.name: RoleManagement-Authorization.Read.All
events.text: Allows the app to read unified role definitions, multi-scope role assignments, and their resource scopes, without a signed-in user.

events.name: RoleManagement-Authorization.ReadWrite.All
events.text: Allows the app to create, read, update, and delete unified role definitions; create, read, and delete multi-scope role assignments; and create, read, update, and delete their resource scopes, without a signed-in user.

events.name: HardDeletionSetting.ReadWrite.Enable
events.text: Allows the app to enable hard deletion protection settings on users, applications, groups, and service principals without a signed-in user. Requires Global Administrator or Backup Administrator role.

events.name: ResourcePolicyAssignment.Read.All
events.text: Allows the app to read all resource policy assignments, without a signed-in user.

events.name: ResourcePolicyAssignment.ReadWrite.All
events.text: Allows the app to read and write all resource policy assignments, without a signed-in user.

events.name: ResourcePolicyConfiguration.Read.All
events.text: Allows the app to read the tenant-wide resource policy configuration, including the configured privileged-read app ID, without a signed-in user.

events.name: ResourcePolicyConfiguration.ReadWrite.All
events.text: Allows the app to read and write the tenant-wide resource policy configuration, including setting the privileged-read app ID used by all fetch() calls during policy evaluation, without a signed-in user.

events.name: ResourcePolicyDefinition.Read.All
events.text: Allows the app to read all resource policy definitions, without a signed-in user.

events.name: ResourcePolicyDefinition.ReadWrite.All
events.text: Allows the app to read and write all resource policy definitions, without a signed-in user.

events.name: ResourcePolicyEvaluation.Read.All
events.text: Allows the app to evaluate resource policies, without a signed-in user.

events.name: AdministrativeUnit.ReadBasic.All
events.text: Allows the app to read basic administrative unit properties without a signed-in user. Does not include membership information.

events.name: AdministrativeUnit.ReadWriteBasic.All
events.text: Allows the app to read and update basic administrative unit properties without a signed-in user. Does not include membership management.

events.name: AdministrativeUnitMember.ReadWrite.All
events.text: Allows the app to read and manage administrative unit membership without a signed-in user.

events.name: CopilotCostManagement-CreditReq.Read.All
events.text: Allows the app to read credit requests submitted in the organization, on behalf of the signed-in user. This exposes request details and the identities associated with each request.

events.name: CopilotCostManagement-CreditReq.ReadWrite.All
events.text: Allows the app to read, approve, and reject credit requests in the organization, on behalf of the signed-in user. Approving a request records the decision but does not itself assign credits.

events.name: CopilotCostManagement.Read.All
events.text: Allows the app to read all organizational Copilot cost management data on behalf of the signed-in user, including any user's credit balance, per-user rankings and itemized usage, usage by security group, spending policies, their configuration and assignments, and the identities of policy creators, modifiers, and alert recipients. This is the broadest Copilot cost management read permission.

events.name: CrossTenantIdentityMapping.Read.All
events.text: Allows the app to read your tenant's cross tenant identity mapping job details as itself, without a signed-in user. Used by authorized services that integrate with cross tenant identity mapping.

events.name: CrossTenantIdentityMapping.ReadWrite.All
events.text: Allows the app to read and write your tenant's cross tenant identity mapping job details as itself, without a signed-in user. Used by authorized services that integrate with cross tenant identity mapping.

events.name: Policy.Read.SecurityDefaults
events.text: Allows the app to read your organization's security defaults policy without a signed-in user.

events.name: Repository.Read.All
events.text: Allows the app to read connected security content source-control repositories and their deployment status, and to discover candidate repositories accessible with a supplied provider credential, on behalf of the signed-in user.

events.name: Repository.ReadWrite.All
events.text: Allows the app to read and manage connected security content source-control repositories, including connecting and disconnecting repositories, on behalf of the signed-in user.

events.name: UserCertificateIds.ReadWrite.All
events.text: Allows the app to update certificate user IDs for all users, without a signed-in user.
